dct_description_sm: This tabular dataset contains a property assessment record for each of approximately 160,000 properties in the City of Milwaukee, Wisconsin as of September 18, 2026. More than 90 fields describe property ownership, assessment, address, building, land-use, zoning, and administrative characteristics. The TAXKEY field can be used to join MPROP records to the City of Milwaukee Parcel Polygons dataset. The source portal states that MPROP is updated daily. Information for properties not assessed by the City of Milwaukee, including manufacturing and tax-exempt properties, is limited and not maintained.
Original source: City of Milwaukee Open Data Portal.
